_comment: Each arm re-enables one slice of YOUR ~/.claude/settings.json on top of a stripped baseline. hooks: keep hooks whose command contains any of these strings. plugins: enabledPlugins ids. env: settings env keys to copy. expect/forbid: substrings that must / must not appear in the run's system events (hook names and hook output); a violation marks the run invalid so an arm that never fired cannot pass for a result. RTK has no session-start output, so it is checked softly: the report shows PreToolUse:Bash hook hits next to Bash vs PowerShell calls.
